items.author: eyesack.bsky.social
items.context: Does anyone else remember a very basic roller coaster designer game from the MS-DOS era? I think there were only two height levels, low poly 3d graphics, first person ridethrough. I played the heck out of it on a school computer
items.text: Can't place that one, but it sounds like a great school-computer memory. Anything you recall about the title screen or the ride camera helps narrow down old DOS games.
